row.title: REGEN-RESEARCH-1: the lane took main's research data and nothing rebuilt the PR's papers
row.body: MERGE-NOW-1 resolves generated files to main's side; REGEN-1 in checks did not run research --page, so a PR adding a study went red after every server reconcile and waited on a session. regen_generated.sh now rebuilds the papers.
